stories.title: Brain Lock Schema and Ownership Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the MongoDB schema for Brain locks including fields for lock_id, owner_id, expires_at, created_at, and lock_state. Enforce ownership semantics and ensure compatibility with TTL indexing.

stories.title: Lock Acquisition and Release API
stories.description: Expose internal service methods for acquiring, releasing, and checking Brain locks with strict ownership validation and TTL awareness. Ensure atomic operations using MongoDB queries.

stories.title: Lock Heartbeat and Renewal Mechanism
stories.description: Implement a renewal mechanism allowing active processes to extend lock TTL safely via heartbeat updates, preventing unintended expiration during long-running operations.

stories.title: Brain Orchestrator Integration with Locking
stories.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal, and release into brain_runner and brain_loop execution paths to ensure single-agent control and prevent concurrent execution conflicts.

stories.title: Lock Lifecycle Audit Logging
stories.description: Log all lock lifecycle events (acquire, renew, expire, release, override) with owner_id and timestamps to support debugging, auditability, and incident analysis.
